jobs.description:
Your tasks

• Lead complex international development, technology and industrialization projects from initiation through market implementation
• Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle
• Coordinate cross-functional teams across Product Management, R&D, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement and Sales
• Act as the primary interface towards internal and external stakeholders, including customers where applicable
• Ensure transparent project governance, reporting and escalation management
• Facilitate project reviews, gate reviews and steering committee meetings
• Drive stakeholder alignment and foster effective collaboration across matrix organizations
• Contribute to the continuous improvement, standardization and professionalization of project management standards, methods and best practices
• Support strategic initiatives and technology development programs
• Promote a Quality First mindset and professional project execution culture

Your profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Natural Sciences or equivalent
• Several years of successful project management experience in an international industrial environment
• Proven track record leading complex development projects and cross-functional teams
• Strong understanding of product development, technology development and industrialization processes
• Proven experience leading product development projects in an international environment
• Advanced knowledge of project management methodologies, tools and governance
• PMP preferred, IPMA or equivalent project management certification is also welcome
• Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management capabilities
• Structured, solution-oriented and resilient personality
• Fluent in English and German language

Why HUBER+SUHNER?

• Grow with us: extensive training & development opportunities
• Enjoy up to 6 weeks of vacation for true work-life balance
• Fresh, affordable meals in our modern staff restaurant
• Support for your well-being with fitness & wellness contributions
• Attractive public transport contribution (Half Fare Travelcard)
• Above-average pension scheme & strong overall benefits package

jobs.title: RF Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Your tasks
In the Industry segment of HUBER+SUHNER, RF and Microwave products are developed and manufactured for global needs. The product management and R&D department for Cable Connectivity is responsible for global product and technology development as well as product management. Our comprehensive product range and expertise include RF Connectors, Cables and Cable assemblies, Lightning Protectors. We are looking for a RF Development Engineer in our Product Development – RF Technology team.

Your profile

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, or a related technical discipline
• Strong expertise in RF/Microwave Engineering, Electromagnetic Field Theory, Material Science, and Component Design
• Experience with electromagnetic simulations and FEM-based tools such as HFSS or CST
• Knowledge of modern RF measurement technologies and laboratory equipment (VNA, PNA)
• Experience with RF components, interconnect systems, or high-frequency assemblies is an advantage
• Knowledge of signal integrity analysis and PCB layout simulations is a plus
• Strong analytical, structured, and solution-oriented working style
• Self-driven, innovative, and passionate about new technologies
• Fluent English is required; German language skills are considered an asset

Why HUBER+SUHNER?

• Extensive training and development opportunities.
• Up to 6 weeks of vacation for a healthy work-life balance.
• Modern staff restaurant with attractive dining options.
• Contributions towards fitness and wellness activities.
• On-site parking and EV charging facilities.
• Contribution to the Swiss Half Fare Travelcard.
• Above-average pension scheme and attractive employment conditions. At HUBER+SUHNER, you will work on technologically advanced high-frequency solutions for international markets. You will become part of an innovation-driven environment equipped with state-of-the-art simulation and development technologies, helping to shape the next generation of RF components and connectivity solutions. Working closely with experts in Engineering, Product Management, Operations, and with customers around the world, you will make a significant contribution to our future success.
